title.en: Infrastructure: which pump follows the pipeline length?
title.zh: 基建工程：管路长度对应哪类泵？

description.en: The infrastructure page says to map pipeline length to listed horizontal distance. The longest printed horizontal cell is Electric 80 at 900 m.
description.zh: 基建页要求把管路长度对照目录水平距离。印出的最长水平格是电动80的 900 m。

h1.en: Infrastructure: which pump follows the pipeline length?
h1.zh: 基建工程：管路长度对应哪类泵？

directAnswer.en: Map the measured pipeline to a printed horizontal cell before you name a pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai says on the infrastructure page that horizontal distance is listed up to 900 m on Electric 80 (HBT80-1816-110). Diesel rows cover remote sites without stable power. This page does not name a highway, a bridge or a country, and it does not treat the highway photograph as a contract.
directAnswer.zh: 先把量到的管路对照已印的水平格，再点泵的名字。邢台河北品锦机械在基建页写明，水平距离最高列到电动80（HBT80-1816-110）的 900 m。没有稳定电源的偏远工地看柴油行。本页不写公路名称、桥名或国家，也不把公路照片当成合同。

heading.en: The horizontal cells you can actually cite
heading.zh: 你真正能引用的水平格

body.en: Electric 80 prints 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical at 60 m³/h and ≤ 2 cm aggregate. HBT80-16 prints 120 m horizontal and 360 m delivery height at 50 m³/h. HBT8018 prints 150 m conveying and 450 m delivery height at 60 m³/h. Diesel 120 prints 150 m / 500 m at 100 m³/h. Diesel 50 and Diesel 60 print 150 m horizontal. LZ-80 prints 120 m conveying, and its delivery height cell says to consult the factory standard. Do not fill that blank.
body.zh: 电动80印的是水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、60 m³/h、骨料 ≤ 2 cm。HBT80-16 印的是水平 120 m、输送高度 360 m、50 m³/h。HBT8018 印的是输送 150 m、输送高度 450 m、60 m³/h。柴油120印的是 150 m / 500 m、100 m³/h。柴油50和柴油60的水平是 150 m。LZ-80 的输送距离是 120 m，输送高度格写的是向工厂标准咨询。不要填上那个空白。

heading.en: Remote infrastructure is a diesel sentence
heading.zh: 偏远基建是柴油那一句

body.en: The same infrastructure page says to review diesel models for remote sites. Diesel 30 through Diesel 60, LZ-60, LZ-80 and Diesel 120 all print “sites without stable grid power” and “rural and infrastructure concrete placement”, except where a page uses a more specific line. Electric 80 still needs a supply for 110 kW. If that supply is not there, do not keep the 900 m electric row.
body.zh: 同一张基建页要求偏远工地核对柴油型号。柴油30到柴油60、LZ-60、LZ-80 和柴油120都印了“电网供电不便”和“农村与基建混凝土浇筑”，个别页面用语更具体时以该页为准。电动80仍然需要 110 kW 的电源。没有这路电源，就不要留在 900 m 的电动行上。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Send the pipeline length in metres and whether a 110 kW supply exists. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请发送管路长度（米），以及有没有 110 kW 的电源。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: No. On Electric 80 it is horizontal. Vertical is 300 m.
answer.zh: 不是。在电动80上它是水平。垂直是 300 m。

question.en: Does the highway photo name a project?
question.zh: 公路照片点名了项目吗？

answer.en: No. The published alt text describes highway infrastructure work. It is not a project case with output or location details beyond the factory’s own pages.
answer.zh: 没有。已发布的替代文字写的是公路基建作业。它不是带产量或地名的项目案例。

question.en: Are boom pumps offered for infrastructure?

answer.en: No. Placement is by trailer pump and pipeline.
answer.zh: 不提供。浇筑用拖泵和管道。
